name: IDLES

whyMatters.en: Bristol post-punk/hardcore band formed in 2009. Brutalism (2017) and Joy as an Act of Resistance (2018, Partisan) put Joe Talbot’s shouted political lyrics over dry, heavy rhythm sections on late-2010s festival bills.
whyMatters.zh: 布里斯托后朋克/硬核乐队，2009 年成立。《Brutalism》（2017）与《Joy as an Act of Resistance》（2018，Partisan）把 Joe Talbot 的喊叫政治歌词叠在干、重的节奏组上，登上 2010 年代末音乐节。

essentialTracks.title: Never Fight a Man With a Perm

lyricQuotes: Danny Nedelko is a refugee / Danny Nedelko is a hard worker

shortBio.en: Bristol post-punk; Never Fight a Man With a Perm shows the chant-riff live mode.
shortBio.zh: 布里斯托后朋；《Never Fight a Man With a Perm》展示口号—riff 现场模式。

body.en:
IDLES formed in Bristol in 2009. Mid-2010s albums made them a festival regular: Joe Talbot’s bark, Bowen/Kiernan guitar scrapes, Devonshire’s heavy bass, Beavis’s hardcore-adjacent drums.

Never Fight a Man With a Perm (2018) is a typical set piece—short riffs, gang vocals, physical stage work. Lyrics name class, masculinity, and NHS-era Britain directly. Ultra Mono (2020) keeps the dry mix on a larger circuit.
body.zh:
IDLES 于 2009 年在布里斯托成立。2010 年代中期专辑使其成为音乐节常客：Joe Talbot 吠叫、Bowen/Kiernan 吉他刮擦、Devonshire 重贝斯、Beavis 偏硬核鼓。

《Never Fight a Man With a Perm》（2018）是典型曲目——短 riff、群吼、舞台肢体。歌词直接点名阶级、男性气质与 NHS 时代英国。《Ultra Mono》（2020）在更大巡演线路上保持干混音。

body.en:
IDLES write post-punk that names Brexit-era Britain in plain speech—Talbot’s shouted lyrics over dry, heavy rhythm sections.

Brutalism (2017) and Joy as an Act of Resistance (2018) landed as UK guitar bands returned to festival stages.

Songs stay short, with hardcore drum feel and gang vocals. Never Fight a Man With a Perm is the usual live citation.
body.zh:
IDLES 写后朋，用直白话语点名脱欧时代英国——Talbot 喊叫歌词叠干、重节奏组。

《Brutalism》（2017）与《Joy as an Act of Resistance》（2018）落在英国吉他乐队重回音乐节时。

歌曲偏短，硬核鼓感与群吼。《Never Fight a Man With a Perm》是常见现场引用曲。

body.en:
2009 founding core: Talbot, Bowen, Devonshire. Kiernan and Beavis join in 2012—the five stay through Ultra Mono (2020).

Dual guitar, no dedicated keyboard; bass and drums carry the groove. Bowen also produces: dry mixes, forward vocal, little reverb wash.

Live shows center Talbot’s physical presence and call-and-response with crowds.
body.zh:
2009 创始核心：Talbot、Bowen、Devonshire。Kiernan 与 Beavis 2012 年加入——五人经《Ultra Mono》（2020）未变。

双吉他、无专职键盘；贝斯与鼓扛 groove。Bowen 兼制作：干混音、人声靠前、少混响。

现场突出 Talbot 肢体与观众 call-and-response。

title.zh: 无怀旧戏服的后朋更新

body.en:
IDLES cite Joy Division and Talking Heads for bass-forward writing, dry vocal, and short song length, while avoiding 1970s costume revival.

2018–20 festival adoption spread chant-riff writing to younger UK guitar bands.

Lyrics about class and toxic masculinity mark them against revival peers. Citation peaks on live sets plus the two Partisan albums.
body.zh:
IDLES 引 Joy Division 与 Talking Heads 的贝斯前置写法、干人声与短曲长，同时避开 1970 年代戏服复古。

2018–20 音乐节采纳把口号—riff 写法传到更年轻的英国吉他乐队。

关于阶级与有毒男性气质的歌词区分于复古同辈。引用高峰在现场与两张 Partisan 专辑。
